qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Co-optimized multi-chamber platforms (Centura, Endura, Producer) and recipe qualification lock-in create insurmountable fab-line switching costs. Massive installed base of >43,000 tools powers Applied Global Services (AGS) recurring annuity, sustaining 47-49% gross margins and 10-year median ROIC of 43.4%. Primary erosion risks are U.S.-China export control tightening and Chinese domestic toolmaker substitution.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global leader in semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment with unassailable process toolkit across deposition, etch, CMP, and metrology. Co-optimized platforms and recipe qualification lock-in create immense switching costs, while >43,000 tool installed base generates an expanding, high-margin service annuity. Reshoring subsidies and AI-driven node transitions (GAA, BSPDN, advanced packaging) provide strong secular demand, offsetting China export curbs. Balance sheet is in a net cash position with >30x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: WFE wafer volume 5.0% + pricing & process complexity 1.5% + AGS service mix 1.0% + net buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 43.4% and tangible operating ROIC of 58.5%, never falling below 27% even in cyclical down-cycles. FY2025 revenue reached $28.37B with $8.29B EBIT (29.2% operating margin) and $7.00B Net Income. Real cash conversion is pristine: FY2025 OCF was $7.96B and FCF was $6.86B, reflecting multi-year FCF conversion of 94.2% of GAAP Net Income. Fortress balance sheet: $7.24B cash vs $6.46B LT debt (net cash of $786M) and 30.8x interest coverage ($8.29B EBIT vs $269M interest). Peak-to-peak earnings power: Owner EPS compounded from $1.66 in FY2016 to $8.66 in FY2025 (17.2% CAGR), achieving new highs at each cycle peak. Leading-edge node transitions to Gate-All-Around (GAA) nanosheets, Backside Power Delivery Networks (BSPDN), and HBM/hybrid bonding expand AMAT's served available market. A $252.5M civil settlement with BIS in February 2026 resolved legacy 2021-2022 SMIC export license inquiries, with DOJ and SEC closing parallel inquiries without charges.
